text: 2.77 Registering Authorities (a) Registering Authority is a body notified by DGFT in this regard to register importers/ exporters as its members by issuing RCMC. (b) The list of notified Registering Authorities is at Appendix -2T. 2.77 Registering Authorities (a) Registering Authority is a body notified by DGFT in this regard to register importers/ exporters as its members by issuing RCMC.
